plan.summary: This 1-4 block fits an off-camp 12-week boxing plan with a build focus. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main percentage-based lift so future loads are accurate, and the main program starts in Week 2. With only 1 S&C session per week, the session stays full-body, power-first, strength-second, then brief accessory and conditioning work that supports sparring without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength, simple explosive ability, and aerobic support with low-complexity work that does not compete with boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and slightly raise power output while keeping the weekly session compact and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen speed and power expression, and stay fresh enough for higher boxing quality.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work to one hard set of 3-5 clean reps. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log the load and reps from the top set so the app can track your squat progress.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop before form breaks and log the load and reps.
